name: dsh-opencode-engine
description: OpenCode engine bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a Host plugin that registers an ACP subagent provider driving `opencode acp`, the /opencode command (real session/load continuation), a fail-closed permission bridge onto ctx.approval, and classified failure receipts.
//: 0.2.10: every @deepseek-ai/* host package is a PEER, never a dependency. pnpm hoists `dependencies` physically into the profile tree (autoInstallPeers is false, so peers are declared, not installed): with rc.2 pins that is exactly how rc.2 dsh-session/dsh-brand/dsh-storage-domain copies landed in profiles/desktop/node_modules and shadowed the rc.5 asar installation, which is what starved `sessions` and crashed the rc.5 boot. Declare peers and Node's resolution routes the import to the running runtime's own copy. Ranges stay tolerant (`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`) so the next runtime bump does not break the bundle admission check again.
